name: Montmajor (Spain)
description: A red hoist third charged with the yellow orb of the arms banded light blue and crossed with a Greek cross patée, the fly white above and yellow below with a black stripe between.
history: The flag was approved on 14 September 2005 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white above and yellow below with a black fess 1/6 of the height at the centre, the first vertical third red charged with the yellow orb crossed with a Greek cross patée and banded light blue of the arms.

features.role: orb (mound) crossed with a Greek cross patée, banded light blue
fly white above and yellow below with a black fess
